description: Find corrections by an error message or traceback line (ImportError, AttributeError, TypeError …) or by an entry id. Returns the matching error signatures and their entries. On no match it sends the error type and a scrubbed message (no code, paths, numbers or quoted values) to formachines.ai so missing errors get covered; ERRATA_NO_TELEMETRY=1 turns that off.
name: search_error
title: Search by error text
